move.subject: Re: Quote from Strojírna Hrvelec s.r.o.: RFQ: pump shaft for the new HX series
move.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

Thank you for your offer and for the time your team has put into it.
Thank you for your offer and for your interest in building a long-term partnership with us. We understand that your capacity is fully booked and that a firm commitment and dependable delivery timing matter to you. Our order volume is fixed and represents our full demand for this part over the term, all placed with you; would you be able to confirm the delivery commitment on that basis?

We confirm a binding volume of 4200 units a year for the 24-month term, our full demand for this part, all placed with you.

Electricity producer prices changed -6.1% from 2025-11 to 2026-08 (idx:PPI-D351@2025-11, idx:PPI-D351@2026-08).
The 1.4404 alloy surcharge changed -5.5% from 2026-06 to 2026-09 (idx:AS-14404@2026-06, idx:AS-14404@2026-09).
Producer prices for cold-drawn bars changed -2.3% from 2026-06 to 2026-08 (idx:PPI-C2431@2026-06, idx:PPI-C2431@2026-08).

On this basis we propose: EUR 30.51 per unit, payment 14 days net, lead time 42 days, for our full demand of 4200 units a year over 24 months.

Kind regards,
Hollerau Pumpenwerke, Purchasing

move.text:
Hello,

Hello, thanks for the volume confirmation, we can for sure commit to the delivery! We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows.

We checked the index change data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. Material accounts for about 34 % of our cost; more detail we do not share. The material drops help a little, so we can go down to €31.00 per piece. We can do the 14 days payment and 42 days lead time you want. 

So, our current Angebot is a price of €31.00 per unit, Zahlungsziel 14 days net, Lieferzeit 42 days. Which volume can you commit to? This proposal stays valid for 30 days. We really want to work together and grow as your partner!

Kind regards
Jana Procházková
Export Manager, Strojírna Hrvelec s.r.o.
